action.__raw: function() vim.diagnostic.config({ virtual_text = not vim.diagnostic.config().virtual_text }) end

root_dir.__raw:
function(bufnr, on_dir)
  local root = vim.fs.root(bufnr, { 'Cargo.toml', 'rust-project.json' })
    or vim.fs.root(bufnr, { '.git' })
  if root then
    on_dir(root)
  end
end

on_attach.__raw:
function(bufnr)
  local gs = require('gitsigns')
  local function map(key, action, desc)
    vim.keymap.set('n', key, action, { buffer = bufnr, desc = desc })
  end
  map(']c', function() gs.nav_hunk('next') end, 'Next hunk')
  map('[c', function() gs.nav_hunk('prev') end, 'Previous hunk')
  map('<leader>gs', gs.stage_hunk, 'Stage hunk')
  map('<leader>gr', gs.reset_hunk, 'Reset hunk')
  map('<leader>gu', gs.undo_stage_hunk, 'Undo staged hunk')
  map('<leader>gp', gs.preview_hunk_inline, 'Preview hunk')
  map('<leader>gb', gs.blame_line, 'Blame line')
end
